clues.text: Told by Isaiah that he would die of his illness, this king of Judah turned his face to the wall and prayed.
Offered a sign of healing, this king of Judah asked for a shadow to go back ten steps, not forward.
This king of Judah took a threatening letter from Sennacherib into the house of the LORD and spread it out before Him.
This king of Judah broke to pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, because Israel was burning incense to it.
This king of Judah showed envoys from Babylon everything in his treasure house, holding nothing back.
This king of Judah blocked the upper outlet of the Spring of Gihon and channeled it into the City of David.
This king of Judah sent letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, inviting them to keep the Passover in Jerusalem.
